## Release Notes [Optional]
<!-- 
Release notes with appropriate tags will be included in automatically generated release notes.
Use the following guidelines to determine if you need release notes:

1. Changes targeting feature branches: Generally NO release notes needed
2. Changes targeting `develop` branch: Include release notes if merchants should be informed
3. Any user-facing changes (UI, workflows, public API changes): Include release notes
-->

### Use appropriate tags for different types of changes:
<fixed>
- Fixed [specific issue] that caused [specific impact]
</fixed>

<new>
- Added ability to [specific capability] which enables [specific benefit]
</new>

<changed>
- Modified [specific behavior] to now [specific new behavior]
</changed>
